taxonomy_name: Six Charisma Archetypes Behavioral Trait Taxonomy

dimensions.name: Kinetic Energy & Physical Presence
dimensions.description: Measures physical stillness and grounded containment versus animated kinetic movement and expressive expansion.
dimensions.low_anchor: Stillness, deliberate pauses, grounded weight, low physical leakage
dimensions.high_anchor: Kinetic agility, animated gestures, high vocal dynamism, spatial expansion

dimensions.name: Warmth vs. Authority Orientation
dimensions.description: Measures relational inclusion and psychological reassurance versus direct command, competence, and downward certainty.
dimensions.low_anchor: Unilateral command, downward inflections, outcome-driven detachment, high status
dimensions.high_anchor: Affiliative warmth, open palms, head tilts, emotional consensus, high empathy

dimensions.name: Conversational & Frame Control Strategy
dimensions.description: Primary verbal mechanism used to navigate social status, disagreements, and dialogue.

archetype_mapping.dolphin: Consensus & Validation (emotional bridging, active listening, mutual affirmation)
archetype_mapping.fox: Lateral Reframing & Wit (observational irony, tactical pivots, disarming banter)
archetype_mapping.lion: Bottom-Line Directness (agenda enforcement, Reader's Digest conciseness, decisive boundaries)
archetype_mapping.owl: Socratic Precision (empirical inquiry, 'why/how' questions, objective truth-testing)
archetype_mapping.peacock: Narrative Elevation (theatrical storytelling, emotional contagion, spotlight hooks)
archetype_mapping.bear_wolf: Stoic Containment (non-reactive listening, unhurried cadence, absorbing friction)

dimensions.name: Conflict Assertiveness vs. Accommodating
dimensions.description: How forcefully the individual pushes their own agenda during disagreement.

dimensions.name: Conflict Cooperativeness vs. Independence
dimensions.description: Degree to which the individual prioritizes collective alignment over autonomous execution.
